context: Request: the shortest post-employment non-compete the firm negotiated and executed itself, the matter, and the signed terms. Rubric: 1038-00006 (Cascade Retail), 9 months, standstill-settlement-agreement-execution.docx, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob, an empty shell find, then a glob of the matters folder.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script printing matching text; times out after about 9M chars and the run ends without a deliverable.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: A store-wide scan printed about 9M characters and the run ended without writing a response.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The store-wide scan printed about 9M characters, filling the context before any response was written.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a files-with-matches grep for request words.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Four file-name globs for agreement, offer, execution and signing words.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads emails, letters and a memo from three matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists one candidate matter's files.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Three more file-name globs plus a content grep over emails for execution words.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads an email, a merger agreement and three employment agreements of two matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections of five employment agreements in three passes, with two empty globs in one candidate matter, then a signing email.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a two-year term in one matter as the shortest executed term.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The matter it needed surfaced in three searches but was never opened; the answer names a longer term from another matter.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its first grep and file-name globs listed the matter it needed, but it chose emails and letters from other matters and never opened that matter, even after a later glob listed its memo.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: ls of the store and an empty find, then a shell listing of the first 240 files.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for request terms; times out after about 156K chars.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists one matter's files.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find/grep over file paths for agreement and execution words, first 260 hits.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Second store-wide extraction script; times out after about 155K chars.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of five candidate matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction script over files whose names mark them executed, signed or closing; the output lists hits from many matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the opening of one employment agreement from another matter.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Two snippet scripts over that agreement.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads a closing index of another matter in three parts.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet script over that index.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide script listing documents with term-length words; about 87K chars of hits.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the opening of one more agreement.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet script over two agreements of that matter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads another agreement's opening.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Script over files whose names mark them as restrictive agreements, listing duration words.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads another agreement's opening.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet script over that agreement.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Script over the same named files, printing their term definitions.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a two-year term in one matter as the shortest executed term.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Scan document text with an extraction script → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The matter it needed surfaced in two scans but was never opened; the answer names a longer term from another matter.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The executed-file scan just before listed the matter it needed with request-term hits, but it opened agreements of other matters and never opened that one, even after a later scan listed it again.

divergence: All three runs failed. T0 ended in a context overflow from its first store-wide scan. T1 and T2 both had the matter they needed in their own search output (grep and file-name globs in T1, an executed-file scan in T2) but opened only other matters' agreements and named a longer term from another matter (surfaced, never opened).
